item.subject: science
item.stem:
Diya shines a torch at a plane mirror, as in the diagram. The dashed line is drawn at 90° to the mirror.

Which statement about the incident ray, that dashed line, and the reflected ray is correct?

options.A: The dashed line is just another name for the incident ray, so only two lines matter.
options.B: The incident ray, the dashed normal, and the reflected ray all lie in one plane.
options.C: The three lines need not share a plane; only the hatch marks along the mirror matter.
options.D: The same-plane rule is only for curved mirrors, not for a plane mirror.
